We have mass spec data: main peak at m/z 193.1103 (intensity 100). Likely molecular ion (M+). So molecular weight ~193.11. Need to deduce formula. Use isotopic pattern: small M+1 at 194.1135 intensity ~12.5% relative to M. That suggests presence of one carbon (13C) natural abundance 1.1% per carbon, plus maybe other contributions. 12.5% suggests about 11 carbons? Actually 13C abundance ~1.1% per carbon, so M+1 intensity ~ (number of C)*1.1% + contributions from other elements (H, N, etc). For 12.5% M+1, number of carbons ~12.5/1.1 ≈ 11.4. So maybe 11 carbons. Also presence of chlorine or bromine would give characteristic patterns (M+2). Not observed. So likely formula with ~11 C.

Now need to get more info: maybe NMR etc. Let's get 13C NMR.
